does_not_change: frozen SCOPE and control prompt/code identities
no-writeback isolation from FutureEval Cycle 1, AKT and XVG
reason_for_pre_retrieval_amendment: ForecastBench dataset questions can carry multiple resolution dates. Reusing the frozen Cycle-1 single-probability treatment/control exactly would otherwise expand one dataset question into many correlated model calls and overweight dataset questions relative to market questions. A fixed balanced sample also bounds compute while preserving a useful paired external shadow test. This amendment is committed before any bound 2026-08-30 question content is retrieved or inspected.

selection.market_candidate_definition: One binary forecast target per mechanically recognized ForecastBench market-source question.
selection.dataset_candidate_definition: One binary forecast target per mechanically recognized ForecastBench dataset-source question, using that question's earliest listed resolution_date strictly after the official forecast_due_date.
selection.ranking_rule: Within each source type, rank candidates ascending by SHA256('640064|<source>|<id>|<resolution_date_or_MARKET>') and take the first 100 unique question IDs. No question text, background, URL, topic, difficulty, forecast value, market value, outcome or current information may affect selection.
selection.if_fewer_than_100_candidates_in_a_source: Use all mechanically eligible unique candidates from that source type and do not backfill from the other source type.

statistics.cluster_rule: Primary cluster is immutable <source>|<id>. Because at most one target per question is selected, each selected pair is one question cluster unless duplicate native event dependence can be identified from non-content metadata by a separately preregistered rule before outcomes are accessed.

authoritative_amendment_time: Git commit timestamp of this amendment
